title: Passage 31
voice: 温暖自然英式女老师｜IndexTTS2.5 慢速教学

sentences.en: Do you have difficulty falling asleep at night?
sentences.cn: 你晚上是否难以入睡？

sentences.en: If so, here's a piece of advice for you: Listen to some soft music.
sentences.cn: 如果是，这里有一条给你的建议：听一些轻音乐。

sentences.en: Scientists have found that soft music can help to improve sleep quality and quantity.
sentences.cn: 科学家发现，轻音乐有助于提高睡眠的质量和数量。

sentences.en: This works for sleepers of all ages, and especially for those with sleeping problems.
sentences.cn: 这对各个年龄段的睡眠者都有效，尤其是那些有睡眠问题的人。

sentences.en: Soft music can help us fall asleep better,
sentences.cn: 轻音乐可以帮助我们更好地入睡，

sentences.en: wake up less during the night,
sentences.cn: 减少夜间醒来的次数，

sentences.en: and feel more relaxed in the morning.
sentences.cn: 并在早晨感到更放松。

sentences.en: You may not notice the effects overnight, though.
sentences.cn: 不过，你可能不会在一夜之间就注意到这些效果。

sentences.en: It could take as many as 3 weeks to see any improvements.
sentences.cn: 可能需要多达3周的时间才能看到一些改善。

sentences.en: Why can soft music help us sleep better?
sentences.cn: 为什么轻音乐能帮助我们更好地入睡？

sentences.en: The reasons aren't clear yet.
sentences.cn: 原因尚不清楚。

sentences.en: It may connect with the relaxing effect of a good song.
sentences.cn: 这可能与一首好歌的放松效果有关。

sentences.en: Music can have real physical effects, too.
sentences.cn: 音乐也会对身体产生真实的影响。

sentences.en: Soft music can lower our heart rate and slow down our breathing.
sentences.cn: 轻音乐可以降低我们的心率，并让我们的呼吸放慢。

sentences.en: This prepares us for sleep.
sentences.cn: 这使我们准备好入睡。

sentences.en: Scientists say that for most people, music that has 70 beats per minute works best.
sentences.cn: 科学家表示，对大多数人来说，每分钟70拍的音乐效果最佳。

sentences.en: Classical, jazz and folk music are usually more effective than other musical styles.
sentences.cn: 古典、爵士和民间音乐通常比其他音乐风格更有效。

sentences.en: Familiar songs work well, too.
sentences.cn: 熟悉的歌曲也很有效。

sentences.en: You may need to test to make your own playlists.
sentences.cn: 你可能需要测试一下，制作自己的音乐播放清单。

sentences.en: And remember to get the volume right.
sentences.cn: 记得控制好音量。

sentences.en: Make sure that the final piece is gradually slowing down, or you may be woken up by the sudden silence.
sentences.cn: 确保最后一首曲子是逐渐减慢的，否则你可能会被突然的寂静惊醒。

sentences.en: It's very important to get enough high-quality sleep.
sentences.cn: 获得足够的高质量睡眠是非常重要的。

sentences.en: Before you go to bed tonight, play some soft music.
sentences.cn: 今晚上床睡觉前，播放一些轻音乐。

sentences.en: Then, just prepare to be rocked off to dreamland.
sentences.cn: 然后，就准备好舒舒服服地进入梦乡吧。
